import java.io.*;
import java.util.*;

public class CF295C_ {

    static int[][][] dp1;
    static long[][][][] dp2;
    static int k;
    static final int MOD = 1000000007;
    static int F, H;
    static boolean[][][] visited;
    static long[][] nCrTable;

    public static void main(String[] args) throws IOException {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        PrintWriter pw = new PrintWriter(System.out);

        int n = sc.nextInt();
        k = sc.nextInt();
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            if (sc.nextInt() == 50) F++;
            else H++;
        }

        initCombinations();
        initDp1();
        int min = solve(F, H, 0);
        if (min > 100000) {
            System.out.println(-1);
            System.out.println(0);
            return;
        }

        initDp2(min);
        System.out.println(min);
        System.out.println(solve2(F, H, 0, min));

        pw.flush();
        pw.close();
    }

    private static void initCombinations() {
        nCrTable = new long[101][101];
        for (long[] row : nCrTable) Arrays.fill(row, -1);
    }

    private static void initDp1() {
        dp1 = new int[2][51][51];
        visited = new boolean[2][51][51];
        for (int i = 0; i < 2; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < 51; j++) {
                for (int l = 0; l < 51; l++) {
                    dp1[i][j][l] = -1;
                }
            }
        }
    }

    private static void initDp2(int minVal) {
        dp2 = new long[2][51][51][minVal + 1];
        for (int i = 0; i < 2; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < 51; j++) {
                for (int l = 0; l <= minVal; l++) {
                    Arrays.fill(dp2[i][j][l], -1);
                }
            }
        }
    }

    static int solve(int fifty, int hundred, int side) {
        if (fifty == 0 && hundred == 0 && side == 1) return 0;
        if (fifty == F && hundred == H && side == 0) return 0;

        if (dp1[side][fifty][hundred] != -1) return dp1[side][fifty][hundred];
        if (visited[side][fifty][hundred]) return 1_000_000_000;
        visited[side][fifty][hundred] = true;

        int ans = 1_000_000_000;
        for (int ff = 0; ff <= fifty; ff++) {
            for (int hh = 0; hh <= hundred; hh++) {
                if (hh + ff == 0 || hh * 100 + ff * 50 > k) continue;
                ans = Math.min(ans, 1 + solve(F - fifty + ff, H - hundred + hh, 1 ^ side));
            }
        }
        return dp1[side][fifty][hundred] = ans;
    }

    static long solve2(int fifty, int hundred, int side, int minSteps) {
        if (minSteps < 0) return 0;
        if (fifty == 0 && hundred == 0 && side == 1) return minSteps == 0 ? 1 : 0;
        if (fifty == F && hundred == H && side == 0) return minSteps == 0 ? 1 : 0;
        if (minSteps == 0) return 0;

        if (dp2[side][fifty][hundred][minSteps] != -1) {
            return dp2[side][fifty][hundred][minSteps];
        }

        long result = 0;
        for (int ff = 0; ff <= fifty; ff++) {
            for (int hh = 0; hh <= hundred; hh++) {
                if (hh + ff == 0 || hh * 100 + ff * 50 > k) continue;
                long ways = (nCr(fifty, ff) * nCr(hundred, hh)) % MOD;
                long subResult = solve2(F - fifty + ff, H - hundred + hh, 1 ^ side, minSteps - 1);
                result = (result + ways * subResult) % MOD;
            }
        }
        return dp2[side][fifty][hundred][minSteps] = result;
    }

    static long nCr(int n, int r) {
        if (r > n || r < 0) return 0;
        if (r == 0 || r == n) return 1;
        if (nCrTable[n][r] != -1) return nCrTable[n][r];
        if (r > n - r) r = n - r;
        return nCrTable[n][r] = (nCr(n - 1, r - 1) + nCr(n - 1, r)) % MOD;
    }

    static class Scanner {
        private BufferedReader br;
        private StringTokenizer st;

        public Scanner(InputStream s) {
            br = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(s));
        }

        public Scanner(String s) throws FileNotFoundException {
            br = new BufferedReader(new FileReader(new File(s)));
        }

        public String next() throws IOException {
            while (st == null || !st.hasMoreTokens()) {
                st = new StringTokenizer(br.readLine());
            }
            return st.nextToken();
        }

        public int nextInt() throws IOException {
            return Integer.parseInt(next());
        }

        public long nextLong() throws IOException {
            return Long.parseLong(next());
        }

        public String nextLine() throws IOException {
            return br.readLine();
        }

        public boolean ready() throws IOException {
            return br.ready();
        }
    }
}
